name: hermes
description: Hermes Agent (weav). SKILL.md-compatible skills in ~/.hermes/skills; subagents via delegate_task; headless via 'hermes chat -q -Q -s vulnhunt'.

install.notes: Unattended runs: configure approvals (command_allowlist) or approvals.mode smart; scans of untrusted code should use a docker terminal backend.

transforms.text:
metadata:
  hermes:
    requires_toolsets:
      - file
      - terminal
      - delegation
